first_case: Historical Keck I LGS AO / TRICK, anchored to Taheri 2024 and Salgueiro 2026
prohibited_claim: An exact reproduction of current Keck I KAPA or measured on-sky residuals

taheri_2024.read_depth: Sections 2-4, Tables 1-2 and simulated/bench dataset descriptions

salgueiro_2026.read_depth: Sections 4-6.2, including sodium-height PSD, sampling and bench residual replay

hcipy_pupil.read_depth: Complete API documentation plus function source from the 0.7.1 wheel

keck_controller_2004.read_depth: Sections 2C and 3C1, DM influence and transfer-function equations; selected sections only

keck_lgs_2006.read_depth: Section 2.2 / Figure 1 and reference-controller discussion; selected sections only

pupil.evaluation: Evaluate the normalized aperture on a pupil grid scaled by 1 / selected_diameter_m; integrate unresolved gap/spider edges by pupil quadrature.
pupil.note: HCIPy model ratios scale with selected diameter. Its documented validation refers to published Keck II studies and internal simulation agreement; this is not an as-built Keck I/TRICK pupil calibration. The library default gap_padding is 10; the explicit physical-gap choice is 1.

published_2024_atmosphere.normalization_policy: Keep the published raw fractions; divide by 0.97 only as an explicit simulator assumption.

residual_evidence.generation: Replayed DM command time series representing median Keck-site turbulence
residual_evidence.note: RMS alone does not define a residual distribution; filtered atmospheric screens are a surrogate until controller/PSD validation is supplied.

benchmark_assumptions.r0_reference_status: Explicit conventional assumption; not stated in Taheri 2024
benchmark_assumptions.layer_strength_policy: Renormalize published fractions by their recorded 0.97 sum
benchmark_assumptions.residual_model: HCIPy frozen-flow layers with an explicitly recorded spatial correction filter; not a full measured-slope Keck AO loop
benchmark_assumptions.residual_strength_status: Study perturbation grid; the 100 nm case is not a published Keck median
benchmark_assumptions.bandpass_status: Study H-band approximation; measured TRICK transmission not provided
full_system_reproduction_requires: Explicit measured-slope or calibrated residual transfer model
Independent instrument pupil and detector calibration

slow_sodium_focus_published.note: A finite sampled process requires explicit low/high frequency cutoffs; do not invent a stationary variance for the unbounded power law. This dynamic experiment follows the constant-label acquisition benchmark.

current_kapa_distinction.note: These current parameters do not retroactively turn the historical single-LGS/1 kHz case into KAPA LTAO.

conditional_followup.gate: Keck physics, held-out estimator and independent-engine gates pass first
conditional_followup.note: Detailed current NFIRAOS overview; 800 Hz is high-order AO, not an OIWFS allocation.

conditional_followup.first_candidate_system: MORFEO / MICADO full-aperture LO and 2x2 SH
conditional_followup.gate: Keck gates pass and a specific instrument sensor/residual model is frozen
conditional_followup.note: 2026 published design; full-aperture LO primarily TT, focus uses 2x2 SH. Dedicated LIFT out-of-focus channel targets petals. HARMONI uses different NGS sensors.

conditional_followup.gate: Keck gates pass and current sensor/detector/residual parameters are verified
conditional_followup.note: Architecture page cites 2013 design and contains TBA tables; approximate 10 Hz focus is historical, not a verified current allocation. Segment piston is a separate target.

conditional_aperture_verification.evidence: Installed signatures/source inspection and constructor-only segment counts; no focal-plane or atmospheric simulation
conditional_aperture_verification.common_call: Use normalized=True, with_spiders=True, return_segments=True; evaluate on pupil_grid / selected_diameter_m. Keep native geometry or explicitly declare uniform rescaling.

TMT.source_epoch: HCIPy source cites official TMT optics and Jensen-Clem 2021 Figure 5 for shadow/support dimensions
TMT.geometry_caution: Official mechanical secondary diameter is 3.1 m; do not substitute it for the published 3.636 m projected pupil shadow without checking the optical projection.

ELT.geometry_caution: Central obstruction is created by excluding segments, not by a circular mask. METIS 2024 simulation uses 0.54 m spiders; TIPTOP MORFEO pupil uses 38.5 m effective diameter with about 0.283 obscuration. These are distinct pupil models.

GMT.source_epoch: GMT-REQ-03215 Rev. F plus source-author corrections to match internal GMTO pupil files
GMT.geometry_caution: Six outer segments are projected ellipses; central segment has truss/diverging supports. No segment_transmissions keyword. Do not replace with seven identical disks or assert current instrument-stop agreement.

H_band_sampling_calculation.policy: 50 mas remains a deliberately severe undersampling control, not an ELT-class sensor specification. Freeze instrument-specific pixels separately.

additional_public_residual_sources.caution: Example runs at 600 Hz and includes config files recursively; source-review all includes and geometry/detector epochs before use. It is not a frozen current 800 Hz NFIRAOS reproduction or supplied residual time series.

Analytical long-exposure residual PSD, not a short-exposure evolving phase sequence. Config reference pixel scale 125 mas differs from 2026 MORFEO paper 165 mas; preserve epochs. HO spatio-temporal PSD includes MMSE/POLC reconstruction and controller assumptions; optional effects are not all modeled.

additional_public_residual_sources.software: COMPASS 5.0 with custom p_metis, p_calibration_DM and p_ccs modules
additional_public_residual_sources.caution: Custom module/data availability prevents claiming an exact stock-COMPASS reproduction. High-order K-band pyramid and auxiliary MIR focal-plane loops are different sensors from MORFEO LOWFS.
